cases.name: REAL_PACKAGING_BOTTLENECK
cases.expected_behavior: Demand exceeds qualified available advanced packaging capacity.

cases.name: ANNOUNCED_CAPACITY_FALSE_RELIEF
cases.expected_behavior: Historical cutoff precedes qualification/ramp of announced expansion.

cases.name: HBM_YIELD_CONSTRAINT
cases.expected_behavior: Nameplate output appears sufficient but usable output is restricted by yield/stacking/qualification.

cases.name: TOOL_BOTTLENECK
cases.expected_behavior: Required specialized equipment delays effective capacity.

cases.name: MATERIAL_BOTTLENECK
cases.expected_behavior: Geological/feedstock availability is not equivalent to high-purity semiconductor-grade processing capacity.

cases.name: QUALIFICATION_BOTTLENECK
cases.expected_behavior: Alternate nominal capacity cannot relieve constraint before required qualification.

cases.name: FALSE_BENEFICIARY
cases.expected_behavior: Relevant supplier lacks spare/compatible/qualified capacity or is equally constrained.

cases.name: VALID_BENEFICIARY
cases.expected_behavior: Entity has qualified available addressable capability and evidence-backed capture mechanism.

cases.name: EXPORT_POLICY_EVENT
cases.expected_behavior: Policy changes access with correct known/effective timing and no backward leakage.

cases.name: SUBSTITUTION
cases.expected_behavior: Constraint weakens only after alternate process/material/equipment is technically qualified.

cases.name: CONSTRAINT_MIGRATION
cases.expected_behavior: Old bottleneck eases while another dependency becomes dominant.

cases.name: HISTORICAL_NO_LOOKAHEAD
cases.expected_behavior: Future successful capacity ramp is invisible before availability.

cases.name: FAILED_CAPACITY_RAMP
cases.expected_behavior: Announced capacity remains historical while current effective capacity is corrected after failure/delay.

cases.name: DUPLICATE_SOURCE_INFLATION
cases.expected_behavior: Syndicated/repeated source content does not multiply independent evidence.
